questions.question: Why do Spring Boot projects usually make custom business exceptions unchecked?
options: Unchecked exceptions do not force throws clauses through every layer
Unchecked exceptions run faster than checked ones
Spring refuses to handle checked exceptions
questions.explanation: Extending RuntimeException lets the exception rise from the service to the advice class without changing every method signature.

questions.question: What is the main benefit of a shared base class such as ApiException?
options: One handler method can reply for every subclass using its status and code
It removes the need for messages
questions.explanation: The base class holds the common status and code, so a single @ExceptionHandler on it covers all subclasses.

questions.question: In the GymFit app, member 2 has an expired membership and tries to join yoga. Which status and code does the client receive?
questions.explanation: MembershipLapsedException fixes status 403 and the code MEMBERSHIP_EXPIRED.

questions.question: QuickPay account ACC-2 holds Rs 300 and a transfer of Rs 1000 is requested. What value does shortByInRupees have in the reply?
questions.explanation: The exception stores requested minus balance, which is 1000 minus 300, so the shortfall is 700.

questions.question: A service catches an IOException and throws new ReportExportException("Export failed") without passing the IOException along. What is lost?
options: The cause, so the real reason is missing from the logs
The ability to catch the exception
questions.explanation: Without passing the original exception as the cause, the log shows only the wrapper and the real reason disappears.
